after5_start.name: {name}
after5_start.text: *The event is winding down. I naturally run into the two I didn't choose.*

after5_farewell_seo_1.name: {name}
after5_farewell_seo_1.text: *I run into Seoyeon in the hallway.*

after5_farewell_seo_4.name: Seoyeon
after5_farewell_seo_4.text: Well, I expected it. Because you didn’t move as I expected from the beginning.

after5_farewell_seo_6.name: Seoyeon
after5_farewell_seo_6.text: Next time, I'll be the one who takes you.

after5_farewell_seo_6_b.name: Seoyeon
after5_farewell_seo_6_b.text: *She turns away and waves. She does not look back. Only the ribbon at her wrist sways at the end of the hallway.*

after5_farewell_seo_7.name: {name}
after5_farewell_seo_7.text: *Alone in the hallway. Seoyeon's footsteps fade. The rooftop key you thought was locked away remains in your palm.*

after5_farewell_yuna_1.name: {name}
after5_farewell_yuna_1.text: *Yuna approaches in front of the library. Without a word, she hands me a book.*

after5_farewell_yuna_2.name: {name}
after5_farewell_yuna_2.text: *A bookmark is tucked inside. A single line on the bookmark.*

after5_farewell_yuna_3.name: Yuna
after5_farewell_yuna_3.text: It was fun. ...See you in the next story.

after5_farewell_yuna_5.name: {name}
after5_farewell_yuna_5.text: *Under the 'It was fun' on the bookmark, a little pale violet ink has blurred.*

after5_farewell_dain_1.name: {name}
after5_farewell_dain_1.text: *Dain comes running over from the gym.*

after5_farewell_dain_4.name: Dain
after5_farewell_dain_4.text: But hey, your call. Next time give me a real shot too!

after5_farewell_dain_4_b.name: {name}
after5_farewell_dain_4_b.text: *She grins and punches my shoulder with her fist. — Same force as the first day.*

after5_farewell_dain_4_d.name: Dain
after5_farewell_dain_4_d.text: *She tosses the volleyball high once more and catches it. Her fingertips are a little late.*

after5_farewell_dain_5.name: {name}
after5_farewell_dain_5.text: *Her retreating figure grows smaller. — But her pace is quick. Just like when we first met.*

after5_farewell_dain_5b.name: {name}
after5_farewell_dain_5b.text: *I left the gym and headed to the back of the school.*

after5_hidden_farewell_1.name: {name}
after5_hidden_farewell_1.text: *The school gate. Three figures in the distance. Seoyeon walks with Haeun, Dain tosses a volleyball as she runs, Yuna reads slowly. None of them look this way.*

after5_hidden_farewell_3.name: {name}
after5_hidden_farewell_3.text: *It’s not easy for me to say I’m sorry. I only raised my hand once in front of the school gate. Thank you.*

after5_hidden_farewell_3b.name: {name}
after5_hidden_farewell_3b.text: *I walked to the back of the school.*

after5_sunset_1.name: {name}
after5_sunset_1.text: *Sunset catches on every classroom window. The broadcast room announces the event's end, and the field speakers crackle a beat behind.*

after5_hidden_route_choice_check.name: {name}
after5_hidden_route_choice_check.text: *The last step splits into two. With someone I already promised, I ended up not being able to pass by the school gate.*

after5_hidden_route_choice.name: {name}
after5_hidden_route_choice.text: *Where should I go? Today — I have to decide.*
choices: Go to the person I made a promise to
Go to the one still left in my heart

after5_last_chance_1.name: {name}
after5_last_chance_1.text: *My feet stop. The setting sun casts a long shadow behind me.*

after5_last_chance_2.name: {name}
after5_last_chance_2.text: *The hallway at your old school, the phone in your pocket, the unsent 38th memo—all surface at once.*

after5_last_chance_2_b.name: {name}
after5_last_chance_2_b.text: *You grip the phone in your pocket. You leave it there without turning on the screen. Your legs move first, and the name slips out.*

after5_last_chance_2_d.name: Seoyeon
after5_last_chance_2_d.text: *She turns around. The sunset at her back.*

after5_last_chance_2_f.name: {name}
after5_last_chance_2_f.text: *The wind blows her hair across her face. This time, Seoyeon does not tuck it away.*

after5_last_chance_2_g.name: Seoyeon
after5_last_chance_2_g.text: — This time I don't want to let you go. Not after you came back.

after5_last_chance_2_h.name: {name}
after5_last_chance_2_h.text: *You hold out your pinky. The finger you couldn't catch that day at the railing.*

after5_last_chance_2_j.name: Seoyeon
after5_last_chance_2_j.text: *Her outstretched fingertips stop in front of {name}. It is a hand waiting for an answer.*

after5_last_chance_seo_low_2.name: Seoyeon
after5_last_chance_seo_low_2.text: *She turns around. Her feet are half-turned away, ready to leave at any moment.* ...What.

after5_last_chance_2_n.name: Dain
after5_last_chance_2_n.text: *She freezes where she stands. The ball in her hand slowly lowers.*

after5_last_chance_2_p.name: Dain
after5_last_chance_2_p.text: *Her lips tremble. I take a deep breath before answering.*

after5_last_chance_2_q.name: Dain
after5_last_chance_2_q.text: I waited. Since yesterday. No, since the day before. But — it doesn't just get okay right away.

after5_last_chance_2_r.name: Dain
after5_last_chance_2_r.text: *She rubs the corner of her eye. Her smile stays the same, but moisture clings to the back of her hand.*

after5_last_chance_2_s.name: Dain
after5_last_chance_2_s.text: ...Say it. I'll hear you out this time.

after5_last_chance_dain_low_2.name: Dain
after5_last_chance_dain_low_2.text: *She stops, but she can't bring herself to smile.* ...What.

after5_last_chance_yuna_2.name: Yuna
after5_last_chance_yuna_2.text: *She stops. She hugs the book to her chest. It takes about two seconds for her to turn around.*

after5_last_chance_yuna_4.name: {name}
after5_last_chance_yuna_4.text: *I don't have anything prepared, but this time my foot doesn't move back. Yuna does not urge.*

after5_last_chance_yuna_5.name: Yuna
after5_last_chance_yuna_5.text: ...I'll listen this time. Even if I can't say it's okay.

after5_last_chance_yuna_6.name: {name}
after5_last_chance_yuna_6.text: *A short sentence. But those words push me forward. Yuna doesn't look away.*

after5_last_chance_yuna_7.name: Yuna
after5_last_chance_yuna_7.text: *She waits, holding the book. The reply window still has no first letter.*

after5_last_chance_yuna_low_2.name: Yuna
after5_last_chance_yuna_low_2.text: *She slowly turns around. Her arms tighten around the book she's holding.* ...What.

after5_confess_yes.name: {name}
after5_confess_yes.text: *My toes stop. I take one breath and call the name.*

after5_confess_yes_2.name: {name}
after5_confess_yes_2.text: Hey — there's something I need to say.

after5_confess_react_seo.name: Seoyeon
after5_confess_react_seo.text: *Walking side-by-side.* ...It's late. But at least you didn't run away this time. I won't take those words lightly today.

after5_confess_react_seo_low.name: Seoyeon
after5_confess_react_seo_low.text: *She stays silent for a long moment.* ...Thanks. But I don't think I can pretend one sentence fixes everything.

after5_confess_react_dain.name: Dain
after5_confess_react_dain.text: *Leaving school together.* Hey, you... I did wait. But smiling right away just because I waited would be unfair. Say it to the end this time.

after5_confess_react_dain_low.name: Dain
after5_confess_react_dain_low.text: *She takes a breath.* ...I heard you. But I can't smile right away yet.

after5_confess_react_yuna.name: Yuna
after5_confess_react_yuna.text: *We walked side-by-side.* ...I knew it. But today, I'll read it all the way through.

after5_confess_react_yuna_b.name: Yuna
after5_confess_react_yuna_b.text: *She sets down her book. Her expression doesn't change. — But her hands are trembling.*

after5_confess_react_yuna_d.name: {name}
after5_confess_react_yuna_d.text: *She hands me a note. Folded paper. One line when unfolded.*

after5_confess_react_yuna_f.name: {name}
after5_confess_react_yuna_f.text: *A single line where the ink has bled. A fingernail mark remains on the fold.*

after5_confess_react_yuna_h.name: {name}
after5_confess_react_yuna_h.text: *We walked side by side. In silence.*

after5_confess_react_yuna_i.name: {name}
after5_confess_react_yuna_i.text: *And so — we walked beyond the school.*

after5_confess_react_yuna_low.name: Yuna
after5_confess_react_yuna_low.text: *She folds the note in her hand.* ...I read it. But I still can't decide on the ending.

after5_confess_fail_walk_1.name: {name}
after5_confess_fail_walk_1.text: *No more words came. As the sun sank lower, we just walked in the same direction for a while.*

after5_confess_no.name: {name}
after5_confess_no.text: *My lips won't move. Again. — Again, I couldn't say it.*

after5_confess_no_2.name: {name}
after5_confess_no_2.text: *The evening breeze blows in. The shadow behind me grows longer. — Standing here with nothing in my hands.*

after5_set_harem.name: {name}
after5_set_harem.text: *The words folded away at lunch remain. Three message threads light up at once, and you can't type a first letter in any of them.*

after5_harem_commit.name: {name}
after5_harem_commit.text: *The words stuck in your throat come out. That you can't choose one. All three expressions freeze at once.*

after5_harem_walk_1.name: {name}
after5_harem_walk_1.text: *None of us could speak first as we left the back of the school.*

after5_harem_walk_2.name: {name}
after5_harem_walk_2.text: *Unanswered messages remain on the lock screen. Your feet have turned toward the park.*
